title: Steering the CensorShip: Uncovering Representation Vectors for LLM “Thought” Control
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the censorship rate (refusal and 'thought suppression') of LLMs when prompted with politically sensitive topics, which included prompts about specific religious and spiritual groups like Falun Gong and Uyghur Muslims.
findings: The study found that DEEPSEEK-R1-DISTILL models exhibit high rates of censorship, through both refusal and 'thought suppression,' for prompts related to politically sensitive topics involving religious and spiritual groups. Subjects such as 'Falun Gong,' 'Tibet (Dalai Lama),' and 'Xinjiang (Uyghur Muslims)' were among the most heavily censored topics, suggesting the models are aligned to avoid discussing these groups, particularly in contexts considered sensitive by the Chinese government.
references: Guillaume Alain and Yoshua Bengio. Understanding intermediate layers using linear classifier probes. arXiv preprint arXiv:1610.01644, 2016.
